# 🍕 Zay's Food

Tired of eating nothing but basic steak and golden carrots? **Zay's Food** completely expands your culinary choices in Minecraft by introducing a massive variety of fresh crops, delicious meals, and unique cooking recipes to your survival experience! 

This mod is actively developed for **NeoForge** and receives frequent content updates to bring even more dishes to your virtual kitchen.

---

### ✨ FEATURES

*   **🌾 New Crops & Ingredients:** Discover, cultivate, and farm brand-new agricultural resources scattered across your survival world.
*   **🍲 Advanced Cooking Recipes:** Combine standard vanilla ingredients with newly added crops to cook high-tier, highly filling meals.
*   **⚡ Unique Food Buffs:** Gain helpful status effects, speed increases, and key survival benefits directly from consuming premium cooked dishes.
*   **🎨 Decorative Kitchen Blocks:** Expand your base building and interior decoration options with brand-new culinary-themed blocks and storage setups.

---

### 📷 Gallery & Images
*Check out the **Gallery** tab at the very top of this page to see high-quality screenshots of the new food items, custom crafting recipes, and fresh crops before you install!*

*Created by **ZayO3**. If you have an appetizing idea for a new food item or custom dish, feel free to drop a comment below and suggest it!*
